concerns.text: Principle VI (Edge‑Hardware Fidelity) requires the evaluation to be performed on the target Raspberry Pi 4 hardware, but the plan targets a Linux x86_64 GitHub Actions runner and never mentions Raspberry Pi 4. This directly violates the constitution.

The plan describes the measurement workflow but does not explicitly state that the generated `InferenceRun` JSON files will be validated against `contracts/inference_run.schema.yaml`. Adding a brief statement linking the run output to this contract would close the plan‑to‑contract mapping.
